verdict.rationale: Docs show PR scans separate pre-existing findings from new ones so reviewers focus on what changed (docs-28), and the API supports 'triage findings' (docs-10), implying some noise-reduction workflow. However, there's no explicit documentation of a false-positive marking/ignore mechanism or a persistent baseline snapshot feature, and community reports flag inaccurate high-confidence findings (comm-3) without confirming a suppression workflow exists. missing for 10: explicit 'mark as false positive'/dismiss UI, documented baseline snapshotting across scans, independent confirmation that dismissed findings stay suppressed on rescans.
